summary: Re-review after the light-touch declutter (logs/clutter_audit_2026-11-21_a.json, level_11 entry). Roxy's 'ooh same, cheese on every... wait. no. dairy and i broke up, and it was NOT a clean breakup' (script[17]) names dairy outright and is a clue rule 6 realisation set off by Liam's cheese pile. The flow holds: Brooke's 'look at us, planning. roxy, lead the way' now follows Roxy's realisation and reads as wrapping up the plan. Every outcome line that points back to the chat still has its setup: Roxy's 'zero dairy, zero regrets', Liam's Little Comet line 'i scraped mine off in solidarity' (his pile in script[16] stays), Maya's 'three days of being brave', and Brooke's 'light night'.
